title: Evidence: language groups (DSEL-01, SCALE-CC-01) and genders of the VoxCeleb2 speakers

inputs.note: VoxCeleb2 official vox2_meta.csv (ProgramComputer/voxceleb vox2/vox2_meta.csv; team copy Experiment/SCALE-CC-01/vox2_meta.csv)

kernel_layout.groups/l_groups_check.json: comparison with the files the system used

notes: value_counts() decides ties of the majority language; a pandas version that orders ties differently would change the group of a tied speaker. The check reports it (FF_ALLOW_MISMATCH=1 keeps the output).
changes_summary: path: dsel01_make_groups.py (copy of Experiment/DSEL-01/make_groups.py): LD and the output folder from FF_VOX2LID / FF_OUT (defaults = original paths)

path: scalecc01_make_groups.py (copy of Experiment/SCALE-CC-01/make_groups.py): DSEL-01 script, FLAG_53 folder, FLAG_42 labels, vox2_meta.csv and output folder from FF_DSEL01_SCRIPT / FF_FLAG53_DIR / FF_FLAG42_LABELS / FF_VOX2_META / FF_OUT
new: cells/00_groups.py: new: run both scripts, compare the outputs with the original files (line ends normalised to CRLF: the originals were written on Windows)
new: guard made mode-aware (guard_policy in stage.json, read by the cell): mismatch -> warn in FF_MODE=train or with FF_ALLOW_MISMATCH=1 / FF_SMOKE=1, fail otherwise (fixer pass 18/11)

build.cell_filter: orig = index of the cell in the original notebook's nb['cells'] list (markdown cells counted; the cell must be a non-empty code cell), CRLF->LF; new: cells/*.py (each opens with print("[cell] ...", flush=True))

cells.title: l_groups: language groups (DSEL-01, SCALE-CC-01) and genders of the VoxCeleb2 speakers

schema: DESIGN.md §2.2 (+ build, notes, changes_summary, outputs.kernel_layout / aliases / scratch / saved_copy)

guard_policy.check: groups/{vox2_groups,vox2b_groups,vox2_gender}.json sha256 (CRLF form) == the files the system used
guard_policy.read_by: the stage's own cell (FF_STAGE_DIR/stage.json; FF_MODE is set by the runner)
guard_policy.why: same policy as l_dqual_g3 / l_lid_audit / l_lid_strict: the FLAG_42 input comes from a GPU run that is not bit-identical when re-run

env_doc.FF_ALLOW_MISMATCH: 1 = a mismatch only warns, in any FF_MODE (the check file records it). Not needed in FF_MODE=train, where guard_policy already warns.
